concepts.title: Typical and atypical thoracic vertebrae
concepts.summary: This concept integrates typical and atypical thoracic vertebrae across the cited cardiovascular sources. Typical T2-T8 vertebrae have superior and inferior costal demifacets on the body and a transverse costal facet for the rib tubercle. T11 and T12 lack transverse costal facets because ribs 11 and 12 have no costotransverse joints.
Long inferiorly directed spinous processes and overlapping laminae characterize the mid-thoracic region and constrain extension.
